project_name: UniStudy - University Study Notes Sharing Platform

features.name: User Registration and Authentication
features.description: Students can create accounts and securely log in to access the platform.
user_stories: As a student, I can register with my university email so that I can access the platform.
As a student, I can log in securely so that I can access my notes and groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid university email, When a student registers, Then an account is created and verification email is sent.
Given valid credentials, When a student logs in, Then they are authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

features.name: Study Notes Upload and Sharing
features.description: Students can upload, organize, and share study notes with other users.
user_stories: As a student, I can upload my study notes so that other students can benefit from them.
As a student, I can browse and download notes shared by others so that I can enhance my learning.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid file format, When a student uploads notes, Then the notes are stored and visible to other users.
Given available notes, When a student searches by subject, Then relevant notes are displayed for download.

features.name: Study Group Creation and Management
features.description: Students can create, join, and manage study groups for collaborative learning.
user_stories: As a student, I can create a study group so that I can collaborate with peers on specific subjects.
As a student, I can join existing study groups so that I can participate in group discussions.
acceptance_criteria: Given group details, When a student creates a group, Then the group is created and the student becomes the admin.
Given an open group, When a student requests to join, Then they are added to the group member list.

features.name: Search and Filter Functionality
features.description: Students can search and filter notes and groups by various criteria.
user_stories: As a student, I can search for notes by subject or keyword so that I can find relevant materials quickly.
As a student, I can filter study groups by course or topic so that I can find groups matching my interests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, When a student searches, Then matching notes are displayed in relevance order.
Given filter criteria, When a student applies filters, Then only groups matching the criteria are shown.

features.name: Rating and Review System
features.description: Students can rate and review shared notes to help others identify quality content.
user_stories: As a student, I can rate study notes so that I can help others find high-quality materials.
As a student, I can read reviews of notes so that I can decide which notes to download.
acceptance_criteria: Given downloaded notes, When a student submits a rating, Then the rating is saved and average is updated.
Given notes with reviews, When a student views notes, Then ratings and reviews are displayed clearly.
